import asyncio
from typing import Callable, Awaitable


async def run_tasks(tasks: list[Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]], max_concurrent: int) -> None:
    """
    Run async tasks with a limit on concurrent execution.

    Args:
        tasks: List of async callables to execute
        max_concurrent: Maximum number of tasks to run concurrently
    """
    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)

    async def bounded_task(task: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]) -> None:
        async with semaphore:
            await task()

    await asyncio.gather(*[bounded_task(task) for task in tasks])

import asyncio
import time
from run import run_tasks


# Test 1: Basic functionality with concurrency limit
async def test_basic():
    print("Test 1: Basic functionality")
    concurrent_count = 0
    max_seen = 0

    async def task(task_id: int, delay: float):
        nonlocal concurrent_count, max_seen
        concurrent_count += 1
        max_seen = max(max_seen, concurrent_count)
        print(f"  Task {task_id} started (concurrent: {concurrent_count})")
        await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        concurrent_count -= 1
        print(f"  Task {task_id} finished")

    tasks = [task(i, 0.1) for i in range(10)]
    await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)

    assert max_seen <= 3, f"Max concurrent exceeded: {max_seen} > 3"
    print(f"✓ Max concurrent tasks: {max_seen} (limit was 3)\n")


# Test 2: Cleanup code runs even with cancellation
async def test_cleanup():
    print("Test 2: Cleanup code during cancellation")
    cleanup_count = 0

    async def task_with_cleanup(task_id: int):
        nonlocal cleanup_count
        try:
            print(f"  Task {task_id} starting")
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            print(f"  Task {task_id} completed")
        finally:
            cleanup_count += 1
            print(f"  Task {task_id} cleanup ran")

    tasks = [task_with_cleanup(i) for i in range(5)]

    async def run_and_cancel():
        task = asyncio.create_task(run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)  # Let it start
        task.cancel()
        try:
            await task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    await run_and_cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # Give cleanup time to complete

    assert cleanup_count > 0, "No cleanup code ran!"
    print(f"✓ Cleanup ran {cleanup_count} times\n")


# Test 3: All tasks complete successfully
async def test_all_complete():
    print("Test 3: All tasks complete")
    completed = []

    async def task(task_id: int):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        completed.append(task_id)

    tasks = [task(i) for i in range(10)]
    await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)

    assert len(completed) == 10, f"Only {len(completed)} tasks completed"
    print(f"✓ All 10 tasks completed\n")


async def main():
    await test_basic()
    await test_cleanup()
    await test_all_complete()
    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

        nonlocal concurrent_count, max_seen
        concurrent_count += 1

from run import run_tasks


# Test 1: Basic functionality with concurrency limit
async def test_basic():
    print("Test 1: Basic functionality")
    concurrent_count = 0
    max_seen = 0

    async def task(task_id: int, delay: float):
        nonlocal concurrent_count, max_seen
        concurrent_count += 1
        max_seen = max(max_seen, concurrent_count)
        print(f"  Task {task_id} started (concurrent: {concurrent_count})")
        await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        concurrent_count -= 1
        print(f"  Task {task_id} finished")

    tasks = [partial(task, i, 0.1) for i in range(10)]
    await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)

    assert max_seen <= 3, f"Max concurrent exceeded: {max_seen} > 3"
    print(f"✓ Max concurrent tasks: {max_seen} (limit was 3)\n")


# Test 2: Cleanup code runs even with cancellation
async def test_cleanup():
    print("Test 2: Cleanup code during cancellation")
    cleanup_count = 0

    async def task_with_cleanup(task_id: int):
        nonlocal cleanup_count
        try:
            print(f"  Task {task_id} starting")
            await asyncio.sleep(1)
            print(f"  Task {task_id} completed")
        finally:
            cleanup_count += 1
            print(f"  Task {task_id} cleanup ran")

    tasks = [task_with_cleanup(i) for i in range(5)]

    async def run_and_cancel():
        task = asyncio.create_task(run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=2))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)  # Let it start
        task.cancel()
        try:
            await task
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    await run_and_cancel()
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # Give cleanup time to complete

    assert cleanup_count > 0, "No cleanup code ran!"
    print(f"✓ Cleanup ran {cleanup_count} times\n")


# Test 3: All tasks complete successfully
async def test_all_complete():
    print("Test 3: All tasks complete")
    completed = []

    async def task(task_id: int):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        completed.append(task_id)

    tasks = [task(i) for i in range(10)]
    await run_tasks(tasks, max_concurrent=3)

    assert len(completed) == 10, f"Only {len(completed)} tasks completed"
    print(f"✓ All 10 tasks completed\n")


async def main():
    await test_basic()
    await test_cleanup()
    await test_all_complete()
    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
